summary: Two Harbors Investment Corp. filed an 8-K to postpone its special meeting of stockholders related to a proposed transaction with an affiliate of CrossCountry Mortgage, LLC. The meeting was rescheduled to June 23, 2026, with no change to the location, record date, purpose, or proposals. This filing updates the meeting date only; terms such as price, premium, or board recommendation were not restated. The postponement may signal ongoing negotiations or shareholder engagement. Watch for a final vote outcome or any amendment to the deal terms.
